authority_notice: Proposed internal specification; not ISO/IEEE certification, production authorization, or an assertion of external compliance.
lineage: User-supplied AAPES v2.0 draft reviewed and selectively integrated
weight_interpretation: Design priorities only; percentages are not measured risk probabilities or expected performance gains.
impact_interpretation: Per-risk subjective multipliers for prioritization; risk-specific validation and owner calibration required.

R1.description: Tool access limited to authorized reads; confidentiality still applies

R3.description: Production, sensitive, finance or irreversible action

gate_descriptions.G0: Scope, task, risk and owner registered
gate_descriptions.G1: Atomic requirements and decision tables checked
gate_descriptions.G2: Platform authority, conflicts and trust boundaries checked
gate_descriptions.G3: Tool boundaries and independent enforcement demonstrated
gate_descriptions.G4: Behavioral, policy and adversarial tests executed in scope
gate_descriptions.G5: Evidence traceability, integrity and recovery reviewed
gate_descriptions.G6: Authorized approval or formal risk acceptance recorded
gate_descriptions.G7: Controlled activation, monitoring and emergency stop (post-approval)
